correctness.rationale: At R0 phi=1 exact population conservation gives J′=J(alpha S_U+epsilon S_V-J). With Z=e^{phi integral lambda}, J=Z′/Z; integrating Z′′/Z′=alpha s Z^{-1/phi}+epsilon v Z^{-theta/phi} gives the exact scalar equation Z′=1-sZ^{-alpha}-vZ^{-epsilon}, Z(0)=1. Since s+v+i=1, 1+it<=Z<=1+t. Fixed-parameter slopes and tJ->1 follow. Counting postinitial infections and subtracting primary events gives exact Q=log Z+J-1+sZ^{-1/phi}+vZ^{-theta/phi}. At T=exp(z/epsilon), epsilon log Z(rT)->z for every fixed r>0; bounded convergence gives Z(T)/T->1-ve^{-z}. These steps prove the full claimed limiting crossover for all stated parameters, independent of finite simulation. The full-equation and reduced-model numerical verifier passed.

originality.rationale: The published leaky-vaccinated SIRI equations and strict-threshold final-size formula are established by Gutierrez & Gog, but their Section 4 omits the equality R0 phi=1 and its parameter-dependent long-time crossover. Katriel proves extinction at the partial-immunity threshold for an unvaccinated model; that result and generic critical decay are excluded from the originality assertion. An exact two-stratum logarithmic-time reinfection-offset crossover was not found in the targeted literature and indexed searches; potential older generalized singular perturbation treatments remain a residual risk.
residual_risks: Specialized older singular perturbation analysis of this exact SIRI vaccinee/reinfection-susceptibility equality line could be unindexed or inaccessible.
Generic center-manifold/critical-slowing theory may subsume the universal tJ->1 support statement; the main originality rests on the vaccinated exponential-time cumulative-reinfection offset.
Some related epidemiological literature was abstract-only, especially 2004 and 2023 variants; no whole-document NOT_COVERING inference is made for those works.
Finite numerical checks do not provide external validation of the infinite-time or joint-parameter theorem.

value.rationale: A source paper’s strict-threshold final-size theory leaves the equality line untreated. The proved joint parameter/time limit reveals a noncommuting vaccine-susceptibility offset and exponentially delayed transition in cumulative reinfections, a mechanistically motivated answer about the duration of apparent critical transience. Neither an arbitrary parameter slice nor a numerical fit, it adds a complete analytic crossover profile to a biologically meaningful boundary. It does not claim general epidemic forecasting or a new generic critical power law.
